This position will be in-office in Houston, Texas. Our summer 2027 internships start mid to end of May and will run through the beginning of August.

Data & AI Enigneering Intern

Location: Houston, TX (Hybrid schedule, 4 days in office)

About TMHCC

Help us insure it. Tokio Marine HCC is a leading global specialty insurance group, backed by the strength and stability of the Tokio Marine Group. With more than 50 years of sustained growth and profitability, and offices across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and other international locations, we offer more than 100 classes of specialty insurance—covering everything from the crops that feed us and the concerts that entertain us to rescuing travelers abroad.

Guided by our Mind Over Risk philosophy, we empower clients to pursue opportunities with confidence while fostering a culture rooted in innovation, collaboration, and trust. Always Advancing, we embrace an entrepreneurial spirit; as Experts in Tomorrow, we anticipate what’s next; and by Reaching Out, we build genuine connections that enable our people and our business to thrive.

Role Overview

We have an exciting internship in our Corporate Headquarters located in Houston, TX. The opportunity is one of the best experiences available, providing interesting and engaging work within a thriving group. The program offers real-world experience in data engineering, AI, and analytics, managed and delivered by the intern team with support from experienced engineers and project leaders.

Key Responsibilities



- Application Development – Assist in designing, developing, testing, and enhancing internal applications using React, Node.js, and Python, following established engineering standards and development patterns.
- AI-Assisted Software Engineering – Use approved AI coding assistants/Copilots to accelerate code generation, debugging, documentation, testing, and refactoring while learning appropriate validation and responsible-use practices.
- API & Data Integration – Develop and consume REST APIs and integrate applications with enterprise data platforms and services, gaining experience with how applications interact with data engineering ecosystems.
- Testing, CI/CD & DevOps – Contribute to automated testing, code quality checks, and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, including participating in pull requests, code reviews, and controlled application deployments.
- Agile Team Delivery – Participate in the team’s software development lifecycle, including requirements refinement, technical design, sprint activities, troubleshooting, documentation, and delivery of production-quality application features.

Requirements



- Minimum 60 complete hours from an accredited college or university.
- Grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 or higher.
- Pursuing a degree in MIS, Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or related field

Preferred



- Full-Stack Development – Academic, project, internship, or personal-project exposure to JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Node.js, or Python and an understanding of basic web application architecture.
- Generative AI & Developer Copilots – Exposure to GitHub Copilot or similar generative AI development tools, including an interest in prompt-driven development and understanding how generated code should be reviewed and validated.
- Modern Software Engineering Practices – Familiarity with Git/GitHub, APIs, automated testing, CI/CD, cloud development, or DevOps concepts; direct GitHub Actions experience would be beneficial but not required.

Equal Opportunity Employer

TMHCC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations, and ordinances.

CareDx is a leading precision medicine diagnostics company advancing care in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy. Through our innovative portfolio of molecular diagnostics, digital health solutions, AI-powered data and analytics, and patient support services, we partner with healthcare providers, patients, and biopharma organizations to help inform clinical decision-making and improve patient outcomes.

At CareDx, every employee has the opportunity to contribute to innovations that help transform patient care and improve lives.

CareDx is seeking an intern to join the Bioinformatics and Data Science group within the Data and AI team. The intern will contribute to the development of clinical tests that inform diagnosis and treatment for transplant patients, applying and developing bioinformatics and statistical methods to analyze next-generation sequencing (NGS) and omics datasets.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with scientists and research associates throughout R&D, including experimental design, data analysis, interpretation, and troubleshooting.

Work closely with laboratory teams to address scientific questions using bioinformatics methods and tools.

Design, develop, and run computational pipelines for NGS and genomic data analysis.

Evaluate the performance of emerging technology platforms and assays.

Maintain clear, detailed documentation of analyses, methods, and results.

Present findings and progress updates at team meetings and to scientific collaborators.

Expand computational biology and programming skills through project work, seminars, and training.

Apply AI-enabled research and structured problem framing to identify and prioritize high-value data opportunities across solid organ transplant and cell therapy and transplant programs.

Evaluate strategic opportunities for new or enhanced data products, biopharma collaborations, and real-world evidence generation by assessing unmet need, data feasibility, clinical and business value, and execution risk.

Synthesize internal and external evidence into concise recommendations, decision frameworks, and pilot proposals for scientific, product, medical, and business stakeholders.

What You’ll Gain

Hands-on experience analyzing NGS and omics data to support clinical test development for transplant patients.

Practical skills in computational pipeline development, experimental design, assay evaluation, and scientific troubleshooting.

Mentorship from experienced bioinformaticians and data scientists, with opportunities to collaborate across computational and laboratory teams.

Experience communicating scientific findings and documenting reproducible analyses.

Insight into how genomic technologies and data analysis translate into diagnostic tools that inform patient care.

Experience using AI as a research and decision-support tool to frame ambiguous healthcare data problems and prioritize opportunities.

Exposure to product strategy, real-world evidence, and biopharma partnership questions in transplant diagnostics and cell therapy.

Minimum Education, Experience, & Specialized Knowledge (Required): 

Bachelor’s degree in Bioinformatics, Data Science, Biostatistics, Biomedical Informatics, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Life Sciences, Physics, or a related field.

Knowledge of bioinformatics and computational genomics.

Proficiency in Python, R, or another relevant programming language.

Experience analyzing NGS data, such as targeted sequencing, whole-genome or whole-exome sequencing, or RNA-seq.

Familiarity with Linux environments, scripting, and version control tools such as Git.

Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

Experience with cloud computing and database management is a plus.

Demonstrated ability to use AI tools and independent research to structure open-ended problems, test assumptions, and develop evidence-based recommendations.

Entrepreneurial mindset and experience evaluating biotechnology, healthcare, or life-science opportunities; prior venture, strategy, product, or company-building experience is a plus.

Duration: 10-12 Weeks, 40 hours per week

Compensation $40/hour

Additional Details

Every individual at CareDx has a direct impact on our collective mission to improve the lives of organ transplant patients worldwide. We believe in taking great care of our people, so they take even greater care of our patients.

Our Competitive Total Rewards Package For US Employees Includes



- Competitive base salary and incentive compensation
- Health and welfare benefits, including a gym reimbursement program
- 401(k) savings plan match
- Employee Stock Purchase Plan
- Pre-tax commuter benefits
- And more!
- Please refer to our page to view detailed benefits at https://caredx.com/company/careers

In addition, we have a Living Donor Employee Recovery Policy that allows up to 30 days of paid leave annually to a full-time employee who makes the selfless act of donating an organ or bone marrow.

With products that are making a difference in the lives of transplant patients today and a promising pipeline for the future, it’s an exciting time to be part of the CareDx team. Join us in partnering with transplant patients to transform our future together.

CareDx, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer-vets/disabled, and participates in the E-Verify program. By proceeding with our application and submitting your information, you acknowledge that you have read our U.S. Personnel Privacy Notice and consent to receive email communication from CareDx. Certain jurisdictions require notice of how we use and protect your personal information. For more information, please read our Privacy Policy

The U.S. EEO posters are available here. 

Note: We do not accept resumes from headhunters, placement agencies, or other suppliers that have not signed a formal agreement with us.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include, but are not limited to, the type and length of experience within the job, the type and length of experience within the industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives and restricted stock units. About Commonwealth Fusion Systems: 
 
Commonwealth Fusion Systems is on a mission to deliver the urgent transition to fusion energy.
 
Combining decades of research, top talent, and new technologies, we’re designing and building commercially viable fusion power plants. And we're working with policymakers, suppliers, and many others to build the energy industry of the future.
 
We’re in the best position to make it happen. Since 2018, we’ve raised $4 billion of capital, making us the largest and leading fusion company in the world.
 
Now we’re looking for more thinkers, doers, builders, and makers to join us. People who’ll bring new perspectives, solve tough problems, and thrive as part of a team. 
 
If that’s you and this role fits, we want to hear from you.


Join the power movement as a Scientific Software Engineering Intern
 
We are looking for a talented Scientific Software Engineering Intern to join our team! CFS interns are highly valued within the organization and placed into meaningful and challenging roles.


Program Details::
• 13-18 week internship 

• 40-50 hours per week with set hourly salary based on year in school 

• Opportunities on site in Devens, MA. If an intern is going to be on site, you will be responsible for your own transportation and housing 

• Specific project assignments and required technical skillset will vary based on the team’s existing need. 

• Opportunities available for currently enrolled college students in all levels of schooling from bachelor’s degree to PhD 

• Interns must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer

What you'll do::
• Port high-performance electromagnetics kernels to the GPU. You’ll start with the Biot-Savart magnetic-field calculation in cfsem , CFS’s open-source Rust library, and extend it to include cross-platform GPU kernel variants with Python bindings 

• Hold your code to a scientific-correctness bar. You’ll check the GPU kernels against cfsem’s existing unit tests and CPU versions, and determine if your methods are accurate enough for engineers who rely on the results to design superconducting magnets 

• Measure and report GPU performance. You’ll benchmark speed and accuracy against the optimized multithreaded Rust CPU kernels, and present a clear recommendation on where GPU acceleration pays off and where it doesn’t 

• Ship public open-source work. You’ll put the new kernels behind cfsem’s existing Python interface so they reach CFS engineers working on SPARC and future fusion magnets, and you’ll leave with merged contributions to a public Rust/Python project

What we’re looking for::
• Pursuing an engineering degree with focus in the field of Computer Science 

• Contributed to a multi-person software project 

• Rust programming language 

• Software performance engineering (class, project or internship experience) 

• Demonstration of exceptional results through a range of different pursuits 

• High self-motivation and drive to execute quickly with excellent troubleshooting/problem-solving skills

Must-have Requirements::
• Willingness to travel or work required nights/weekends/on-call occasionally 

• Perform activities such as typing, standing, or sitting for extended periods of time 

• Dedication to safety to mitigate industrial hazards that may include heat, cold, noise, fumes, strong magnets, lead (Pb), high voltage, and cryogenics

#LI-Onsite


At CFS, we excel in fast-paced environments, driven by our values of integrity, execution, impact, and self-critique. As we grow, we’re eager to bring on mission-driven folks who offer diverse perspectives and fresh ways to tackle challenges.
 
We value diversity deeply and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer by choice. We consider all qualified applicants equally, regardless of race, color, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, protected veteran status, religion, physical or mental disability, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, or any other basis protected by law.
 
This role requires compliance with U.S. laws concerning the export of controlled or protected technologies or information (collectively, “Export Control Laws"). Any offer of employment will be contingent on the need for compliance with such Export Control Laws.
fit_why: Rust GPU/electromagnetics kernels; he lacks Rust and HPC experience

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . 
 Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.
 
 Department Overview
 The AI Engineering Platform team builds and operates the cloud infrastructure, platforms, and automation capabilities that power Micron's analytics, machine learning, and AI workloads. By using cloud-native technologies, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and AI-enabled solutions, the team delivers scalable, secure, and reliable platforms that accelerate innovation and engineering productivity across the enterprise.

 Position Overview
 As a Platform Engineering Intern, you will work alongside experienced engineers to support the infrastructure and platforms that enable AI, analytics, and cloud-based solutions at Micron. You will gain hands-on experience with cloud technologies, Kubernetes, automation, Infrastructure as Code, AI-enabled tools, and platform operations while contributing to real-world projects that improve scalability, reliability, and engineering efficiency.

 Responsibilities
 
• Support cloud platform, Kubernetes, and infrastructure projects while collaborating with global platform engineering teams. 
• Develop scripts, automation tools, dashboards, and monitoring solutions that improve platform reliability, operational visibility, and resource utilization. 
• Assist with platform support, operational activities, and customer requests while learning enterprise platform engineering protocols. 
• Evaluate emerging technologies, build proof-of-concept solutions, and contribute to platform improvements related to cloud infrastructure, AI, and automation. 
• Develop and leverage AI-powered tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and decision-making. 
 Minimum Qualifications
 
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through coursework, academic projects, personal projects, hackathons, or internships in software development, cloud computing, infrastructure, or platform engineering. 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field. 
• Experience programming in Python, Go, Java, Bash, or similar languages. 
• Familiarity with Linux/Unix systems, cloud computing concepts, and modern software development fundamentals. 
• Strong problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and analytical skills with demonstrated interest in Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), AI platforms, Generative AI, and Agentic AI technologies. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 
• Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or cloud platforms through coursework, projects, certifications, or internships. 
• Familiarity with Git, version control systems, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation practices. 
• Knowledge of AI/ML platforms, machine learning frameworks, data pipelines, SQL, or analytics technologies. 
• Experience building automation tools, AI-assisted workflows, dashboards, monitoring solutions, or cloud-native applications. 
• Interest in pursuing a career in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or AI Infrastructure.

Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all .

 Department Overview
 The Data Science team employs advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI technologies to improve semiconductor manufacturing performance and decision-making. By combining statistical methods, engineering expertise, and AI-enabled solutions, the team transforms complex manufacturing data into actionable insights that drive operational excellence and innovation across Micron.

 Position Overview
 As a Data Science Intern, you will work at the intersection of statistical analysis, machine learning, and AI agents to solve real-world semiconductor manufacturing challenges. You will apply time-series analytics, change-point detection, machine learning, and large language model (LLM) technologies to identify important patterns in manufacturing data and develop AI-enabled solutions that help engineers make better decisions.

 Responsibilities
 
• Apply statistical and machine learning techniques, including time-series analysis, change-point detection, clustering, and dimensionality reduction, to identify trends and anomalies in semiconductor manufacturing data. 
• Develop and evaluate AI agents and LLM-enabled workflows by integrating analysis tools, designing prompts, and assessing model performance against known outcomes. 
• Extract, clean, integrate, and analyze data using SQL, Python, and analytical tools to support engineering investigations and decision-making. 
• Build reproducible analytics, visualizations, dashboards, and reporting solutions that provide actionable insights to engineering teams. 
• Present technical findings, recommendations, and limitations clearly to engineering partners while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. 
 Minimum Qualifications
 
• 0-2 years of relevant experience through coursework, research, internships, academic projects, hackathons, or data science competitions. 
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with an expected graduation date between December 2027 and June 2028. 
• Experience with Python for data analysis, including libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, or similar tools, and basic SQL for data extraction and preparation. 
• Knowledge of statistics, machine learning fundamentals, hypothesis testing, regression, clustering, PCA, and data analysis methodologies gained through coursework or projects. 
• Experience using AI technologies, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, or generative AI platforms through academic, personal, or project-based work, along with strong analytical, communication, and collaboration skills. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 
• Experience with time-series analysis, forecasting, anomaly detection, change-point detection, or statistical modeling techniques. 
• Familiarity with LLM agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph, prompt engineering, or AI workflow orchestration frameworks. 
• Experience evaluating AI model performance, validating outputs, mitigating hallucinations, or developing AI-assisted applications and workflows. 
• Proficiency with data science and machine learning tools such as Scikit-learn, XGBoost, SHAP, SciPy, R, JMP, Plotly, or similar platforms. 
• Experience applying analytics, machine learning, or AI technologies to manufacturing, engineering, scientific research, or other real-world datasets, with an interest in semiconductor manufacturing and industrial analytics.

The JM Family College Internship Program is designed to create an opportunity for college students to have meaningful work experiences that tie to their programs of study. As part of this program, you will actively contribute to your team’s success, learn about JM Family’s companies and culture while obtaining new skills through learning opportunities, networking events and much more.
  
 The ideal candidate will be available to work full-time during the Summer Internship Program ( May 24th, 2027 - July 30th, 2027 ).
  
 Interns will engage in meaningful work and gain insights into specific projects or tasks, providing hands-on experience, and contributing to various department initiatives. They will learn about JM Family’s culture including our core values: Consideration, Cooperation, Communication, Innovation and Accountability. These core values are part of our keys to success and the skills that embody these values are what drive our success as an organization.
  
 As a Data Engineering Intern , you will gain hands-on experience supporting data initiatives focused on improving and modernizing the team’s data environment. This role will provide exposure to both data engineering and analytics, offering the opportunity to apply technical coursework to real-world business needs while contributing to ongoing data warehouse modernization efforts.
